title: #329 Computer
prompt: Some people say that computers have made life easier and more convenient. Other people say that computers have made life more complex and stressful. Do you agree with that?

promptSegments.text: Some people say that computers have made life easier and more convenient.
Other people say that computers have made life more complex and stressful.

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.
requirements.vi: Hỗ trợ quan điểm bằng hai lý do rõ ràng.

requirements.en: Use relevant examples when they strengthen an idea.
requirements.vi: Dùng ví dụ phù hợp khi chúng làm rõ ý.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Computers make daily tasks easier because they provide fast ways to find information and complete tasks.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Computers make daily tasks easier because they provide fast ways to find information and complete tasks.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Computers help people connect with others through digital communication, keeping relationships strong.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Computers help people connect with others through digital communication, keeping relationships strong.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Computers make daily life easier by providing fast ways to find information and complete tasks, eliminating the need to visit multiple physical locations.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Computers make daily life easier by providing fast ways to find information and complete tasks, eliminating the need to visit multiple physical locations.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Furthermore, computers allow people to maintain connections with friends and family far away, supporting better emotional bonds.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Furthermore, computers allow people to maintain connections with friends and family far away, supporting better emotional bonds.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Computers make life easier by providing access to information and helping with daily tasks.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Computers make life easier by providing access to information and helping with daily tasks.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Computers make life better by allowing people to stay connected with others globally.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Computers make life better by allowing people to stay connected with others globally.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The first body paragraph argues that computers are beneficial for education and learning.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The first body paragraph argues that computers are beneficial for education and learning.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The second body paragraph argues that computers are essential for improving business efficiency and communication.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The second body paragraph argues that computers are essential for improving business efficiency and communication.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.
promptTraps.vi: Không viết bài chung chung về chủ đề mà không trả lời đúng yêu cầu của đề.

promptTraps.en: Do not explain the statement without making your own position clear.
promptTraps.vi: Không chỉ giải thích nhận định mà quên nêu rõ quan điểm cá nhân.

faq.questionVi: Đề này đang hỏi điều gì?
faq.answerEn: Break the prompt into its direct requirements before choosing ideas.
faq.answerVi: Hãy tách đề thành các yêu cầu trực tiếp trước khi chọn ý.

faq.questionEn: How many main ideas should I use?
faq.questionVi: Tôi nên dùng bao nhiêu ý chính?
faq.answerEn: Use two developed points with explanation and relevant examples.
faq.answerVi: Dùng hai luận điểm được phát triển bằng giải thích và ví dụ phù hợp.

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?
faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?
faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.
faq.answerVi: Có, nếu ví dụ trực tiếp hỗ trợ luận điểm và vẫn liên quan đến đề.

faq.answerEn: Avoid memorised general sentences and any idea that does not answer the task.
faq.answerVi: Tránh câu chung học thuộc và mọi ý không trả lời đúng yêu cầu.
